room.mill_yard.title: Mill Yard
room.mill_yard.description: Flour dust greys the cobbles. A [handcart](cart) sits mired to its axles in the ruts.
room.wayside.title: Wayside
room.wayside.description: The road bends past a moss-grown [shrine](shrine) where travellers leave their prayers.
detail.cart: A handcart sunk deep in the mud. It would take a hale body to shift it.
detail.cart.moved: The handcart stands free of the ruts now, its wheels caked in mud.
detail.shrine: A little stone shrine, its niche worn smooth by hands.
narration.shove_cart.success: You set your shoulder to the cart and heave. It lurches free of the ruts.
narration.shove_cart.failure: You heave at the cart, but you are too weak to shift it.
narration.pray.actor: You bow your head at the shrine. Warmth steadies your limbs.
